note: The normative JSON Schemas live in the spec repository. This pin records the exact tree they were vendored from. Run `pnpm schemas:sync` to re-copy after bumping `ref`. Until the push-pipeline retirement (issue #52, Phase 3) the local schemas/ directory also holds four retired schemas (product-change, delivery-slice, product-handoff, product-coverage) that are absent from the spec repo and are not overwritten by the sync script.
